subject.title: refactor(state): split openclaw-state-db into focused modules under the line limit

question: After fresh-install and upgrade-database lifecycle evidence is attached, should the state owners approve this behavior-preserving decomposition of persisted-state migration code?
rationale: The refactor moves compatibility-sensitive migration and startup code, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human judgment rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Require lifecycle proof, then review
options.body: Request redacted evidence for a fresh database open and an upgraded existing database open, then make the normal maintainer merge decision.

options.title: Pause for a narrower split
options.body: If review of the extracted migration ownership is too broad, pause this branch and request a smaller decomposition with the same public facade boundary.

recommendation.title: Require lifecycle proof, then review
recommendation.body: Request redacted evidence for a fresh database open and an upgraded existing database open, then make the normal maintainer merge decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this contributor to the proposed state refactor and adjacent merged module-splitting work.
